title: Bend: go in with a plan

creative.constraint: one figure per beat, navy and cream only, every move eased on the brand curve
creative.lineage: Swiss International Typographic Style posters (Josef Muller-Brockmann)
creative.one_sentence: Bend's 3.5 months of supply, read on a ruler, tells a buyer to go in with a plan.
